scope.purpose: Immutable handoff for isolated native vehicle crash-solver batch candidates and their evidence.

ownership_contract.missing_retire_behavior: Claim intentionally remains fail-closed; a different executor cannot bind that solver.
ownership_contract.unexpected_worker_rejection: Poison session and publish no snapshots.

coverage: main-thread API gates including real Thread adversary
typed solver method and runtime admission

api: begin_step_batch_rows([{vehicle_id, life_generation, delta, speed, throttle, physics_tick}, ...]) -> Dictionary
step_batch_rows([{vehicle_id, life_generation, delta, speed, throttle, physics_tick}, ...]) -> Dictionary

input_and_output_contract.published_states_order: Bound-slot order, not caller input-row order.
input_and_output_contract.consumer_mapping_rule: Map each published state by returned vehicle_id and life_generation.
input_and_output_contract.single_state_step_batch_rows_path: Synchronous direct solver.step fast path with the same published schema.
input_and_output_contract.single_state_begin_step_batch_rows_path: Asynchronous group path inherited from the base candidate.
input_and_output_contract.multi_state_step_batch_rows_note: Current implementation validates/maps rows once before begin and again inside begin; correct but adds avoidable main-thread allocation/work.

coverage: reversed input rows mapped to bound-slot output order
malformed, stale, duplicate, missing, and unknown row rejection

independent_tick_test.coverage: Three profile/lifetime clocks differ across two reversed-row batches; output equals serial full snapshots; one stale row rejects the whole batch without mutation.

workload.other_concurrent_work: Actual compact transport deformation job on the same global WorkerThreadPool.

combined_worker_pool_contention_stress.independent_result: PASS 17; source/native math and geometry parity retained in the isolated contention run.
combined_worker_pool_contention_stress.qualification: This deliberately distinct delta=0.1 workload measures joined wall-clock contention on the shared global worker pool. It is not the normal 120/60/30 Hz batch benchmark, not LIVE, not FPS, not aggregate CPU time, and not adoption evidence.

measurement_policy.reported_metric: Host- and process-specific wall-clock latency around complete batch submission/join or the named stress scope.
measurement_policy.successful_test_meaning: Evidence for isolated API, parity, lifecycle, and race-boundary behavior only.

integration_blockers: No production body, provider, main-scene, or runtime caller is wired to either candidate.
A future owner must prove lifecycle calls always reach retire_wait so claims are released.
A future owner must serialize all solver mutation through the selected executor while bound or in flight.
A future owner must assess global WorkerThreadPool contention with other transport and navigation jobs in the actual runtime.
Passing candidate tests must not be described as LIVE adoption.
